notes.title: Blog post #4
notes.content:
Happy new year everyone. Hope all is going well. Here's an update, sweet and to the point. 

[list]
[*]Added invert yaw and pitch axis in the esc menu. 
[*]Changed 1st and 2nd floor houses to more solid structures (no 3rd floor yet.)
[*]Tab allows you to change the color of the clothes of the AI being spawned (using E.)
[*]Sun position can be set from the top right of the screen using the slider. 
[*]Food farms are now wheat-looking fields. 
[*]Trees are spawned at start. 
[*] Some other stuff.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38828385/84e15fc2ff9fd9430346c7f71df0667da0a11dfc.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38828385/5fa23ad16d6b691107f6cd2d2501016a780eb4fc.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38828385/6ed9578e67414f1eae1d7f22423df6e020314f88.png[/img]

I've had to limit the maximum number of AI to 200 due to performance reasons. Apparently, AI is very process and task intensive, who knew... 

Please enjoy.
